name: EZ File Server
summary:
No cable? No problem. EZ File Server puts a file server inside your Quest.

THREE WAYS IN
HTTP: open the address in any browser on your PC, Mac or phone. Upload files and whole folders, download files, grab a folder as a ZIP, create and delete folders. Big buttons that work on touch screens too.
WebDAV: add the headset as a network drive in Windows ("Map network drive"), macOS Finder ("Connect to Server") or any WebDAV app, and work with it like a USB disk.
FTP: connect with FileZilla, Total Commander, Wind
